remarks: Stunning 2,208 sq ft home combining timeless style with modern function, featuring a rear-attached garage and charming covered front porch for standout curb appeal.   The bright front entry opens to a spacious great room with fireplace and nook, highlighted by an open-to-below design that fills the home with natural light. The chef-inspired kitchen offers quartz counters, a large island with eating ledge, Silgranit undermount sink, built-in microwave, custom hood fan with full-height backsplash, and upgraded Thermofoil cabinets with soft-close features, plus a generous butler’s pantry.   A main floor den with storage adds flexible space. Rear foyer, mudroom, side entry, and half bath enhance convenience and future suite potential.   Upstairs includes a primary suite with 5-piece ensuite and walk-in closet, bonus room, laundry, two bedrooms, and a full bath. Finished with brushed nickel fixtures and basement rough-in plumbing.
